mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM pcd_space_member_table m LEFT JOIN pcd_user_info_table u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY m.role DESC, m.joined_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_space_member_table (space_id, user_id, role, invited_by) VALUES (#{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{role}, #{invitedBy,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_space_member_table WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
